units.source_text: 说也奇怪，在汽车进入山谷以前，秀男又两次看到类似的彩虹。

en.t: Strangely enough, before the car entered the valley, Hideo saw similar rainbows twice more.

units.source_text: 前后三次，彩虹也都没有完全成弓形，有些地方总显得淡薄些。

en.t: All three times, the rainbows never formed a complete arch, and some parts always seemed rather faint.

units.source_text: 本来这是常见的现象，可是秀男今天却有点放心不下，

en.t: Ordinarily this was a common enough phenomenon, but today Hideo felt somehow uneasy about it,

units.source_text: 他心里总嘀咕：“噢，彩虹是吉利的象征呢，还是凶邪的标志？”

en.t: and in his heart he kept muttering, "Oh, is a rainbow a sign of good fortune, or an omen of evil?"
